visits_percent_other_pos.label: Other settings
visits_percent_other_pos.help: Share of visits in any other place of service. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

mips_final_score.label: MIPS final score
mips_final_score.help: CMS Merit-based Incentive Payment System final score, latest published year.

open_payments_year.label: Open Payments year
open_payments_year.help: Not shown. Open Payments was retired from the directory.

practices.label: Sites
practices.help: Up to 5 practice locations ranked by the clinician's visits there, from claims.

group_practices.label: Group practices
group_practices.help: Every organization the clinician billed under in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025, primary first.

hospital_affiliations.label: Facility affiliations (not shown)
hospital_affiliations.help: Not shown in the UI. A visit-based grouping of facilities whose parent grouping data is not reliable enough to display.

referrals.label: Referrals
referrals.help: Top 3 clinicians who refer to this clinician, and top 3 this clinician refers to.

practice_name.label: Primary site
practice_name.help: Name of the clinician's primary practice site.

city.label: City
city.help: City of the clinician's primary practice site.

state.label: State
state.help: State of the clinician's primary practice site.

organization_id.label: Organization id
organization_id.help: Billing identifier of the group. Members are the clinicians whose primary organization this is.

parent_id.label: Parent organization id
parent_id.help: Identifier of the group's parent organization.

parent_name.label: Parent organization
parent_name.help: Parent organization of the group, as recorded in the warehouse.

provider_count.label: Clinicians
provider_count.help: Number of individual clinicians whose primary organization is this group.

active_provider_count.label: Active clinicians
active_provider_count.help: Members with at least one visit or panel patient in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

in_system_provider_count.label: In-system clinicians
in_system_provider_count.help: Members with a CMS hospital affiliation.

visits_per_provider.label: Visits per clinician
visits_per_provider.help: Group visits divided by number of member clinicians.

visits_percentile.label: Visits percentile
visits_percentile.help: Where this group's visit total ranks among all groups. 100 is the highest.

activity_percentile.label: Activity percentile
activity_percentile.help: Where this group's visits per clinician ranks among all groups. 100 is the highest.

visits_are_summed_across_npis.label: Summed across clinicians
visits_are_summed_across_npis.help: Volume on this page is summed across member clinicians.

npi.label: NPI
npi.help: The clinician this site belongs to.

site_rank.label: Rank
site_rank.help: Site order by the clinician's visits there. 1 is the primary site.

sl_code.label: Location code
sl_code.help: Warehouse code of the busiest location in this site.

cluster_key.label: Site key
cluster_key.help: Key that groups suite variants of one address into a single site.

latitude.label: Latitude
latitude.help: Latitude of the site. Not used by the UI in v1.

longitude.label: Longitude
longitude.help: Longitude of the site. Not used by the UI in v1.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: Phone number from CMS for this clinician at this address, when one matches. Blank means no match; never invented.

work_type.label: Work type
work_type.help: Type of care setting, from the place-of-service code on claims.

visits_at_site.label: Visits at site
visits_at_site.help: The clinician's visits at this site in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

visit_share_pct.label: Visit share
visit_share_pct.help: Share of the clinician's visits that happened at this site. Sites past the top 5 and visits with no location keep the shares from adding to 100.

npi_type.label: Location type
npi_type.help: Whether the location code is an organization (2) or an individual (1).

location_source.label: Location source
location_source.help: Where the address came from. Always claims today.

location_flag.label: Location status
location_flag.help: Confidence flag for the address. Always claims-confirmed today.

phone_source.label: Phone source
phone_source.help: Where the phone came from: CMS PDC, or blank.

needs_geocode.label: Needs geocode
needs_geocode.help: The warehouse has no coordinates for this location.

wrvu_at_site.label: RVU sum at site
wrvu_at_site.help: The clinician's one-procedure-per-visit RVU sum over visits at this site.

wrvu_share_pct.label: Share of RVU sum at site
wrvu_share_pct.help: This site's part of the clinician's RVU sum.

visits_percent_monday.label: Monday %
visits_percent_monday.help: Share of the clinician's visits at this site that fell on a Monday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share.

visits_percent_tuesday.label: Tuesday %
visits_percent_tuesday.help: Share of the clinician's visits at this site that fell on a Tuesday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share.

visits_percent_wednesday.label: Wednesday %
visits_percent_wednesday.help: Share of the clinician's visits at this site that fell on a Wednesday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share.

visits_percent_thursday.label: Thursday %
visits_percent_thursday.help: Share of the clinician's visits at this site that fell on a Thursday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share.

visits_percent_friday.label: Friday %
visits_percent_friday.help: Share of the clinician's visits at this site that fell on a Friday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share.

visits_percent_saturday.label: Saturday %
visits_percent_saturday.help: Share of the clinician's visits at this site that fell on a Saturday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share.

visits_percent_sunday.label: Sunday %
visits_percent_sunday.help: Share of the clinician's visits at this site that fell on a Sunday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share.

npi.label: NPI
npi.help: The clinician this organization row belongs to.

org_rank.label: Rank
org_rank.help: Order of the clinician's organizations: primary first.

organization_name.label: Organization
organization_name.help: Name of the organization the clinician billed under.

billing_type.label: Billing type
billing_type.help: P for professional claims, I for institutional claims. Blank when the row came only from the primary affiliation.

is_primary.label: Primary
is_primary.help: This is the clinician's primary billing organization.

cases.label: Cases
cases.help: Case count the warehouse attributes to the clinician at this organization.

max_period_code.label: Last month billed
max_period_code.help: Latest month (YYYYMM) the clinician billed under this organization.

npi.label: NPI
npi.help: The clinician this affiliation belongs to.

affiliation_rank.label: Rank
affiliation_rank.help: Not shown in the UI. Affiliated organizations ordered by the clinician's visits there, at most 5.

hospital_system_name.label: Affiliated organization (not shown)
hospital_system_name.help: Not shown in the UI. Parent organization of the facilities where the clinician's visits took place; facilities of one parent are combined.

facility_name.label: Facility
facility_name.help: The busiest facility within the organization, when it has its own name.

sl_code.label: Location code
sl_code.help: Warehouse code of the busiest campus.

visits_at_system.label: Visits at organization
visits_at_system.help: The clinician's visits across all sites of this organization in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

visit_share_pct.label: Visit share
visit_share_pct.help: Share of the clinician's visits that took place at this organization.

provider_count.label: Clinicians
provider_count.help: On a group page, number of member clinicians affiliated with this organization.

npi.label: NPI
npi.help: The clinician this referral row belongs to.

direction.label: Direction
direction.help: in: clinicians who send patients to this clinician. out: clinicians this clinician sends patients to.

peer_npi.label: Peer NPI
peer_npi.help: NPI of the referring or receiving clinician.

peer_name.label: Peer
peer_name.help: Name of the referring or receiving clinician.

peer_specialty.label: Peer specialty
peer_specialty.help: Specialty of the referring or receiving clinician.

patient_count.label: Patients
patient_count.help: Patients referred between the two clinicians in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025. Monthly counts are summed, so a patient referred in three months counts three times.

claim_count.label: Claims
claim_count.help: Claims behind the referral relationship in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

npi.label: NPI
npi.help: The clinician this utilization row belongs to.

rk.label: Rank
rk.help: Procedure categories ordered by CMS percentile.

count_label.label: Volume
count_label.help: CMS volume label for the category.
